systems.country_label: Crime Statistics Information Management System; also called the police's online case management system and the crime statistics database
systems.owner: Liberia National Police, with technical and financial support from UNDP's Joint Rule of Law programme
systems.tiers: Stated as established and rolled out nationwide in 2024, collecting crime statistics digitally around the country; no count of stations or counties given

systems.owner: Judiciary of Liberia, with UNDP support
systems.tiers: Montserrado County courts: court clerks file cases digitally; a court system, not a police one, and outside the typology's classes

note: No fact: the one passage on the police (page 25) says its online case management system moved the force from manually collecting and tabulating crime statistics to collecting them digitally, and that the Crime Statistics Information Management System is rolled out nationwide, making crime statistics reports timely. That describes statistics, not a station's record of a report or case. The rest of the report is on other sectors.
